topic: How does the ocean move heat around Earth?

sources.title: What is the global ocean conveyor belt?

scenes.headline: EARTH'S HIDDEN HEAT ENGINE
scenes.caption: The ocean stores solar energy and moves it around the planet. This invisible transport helps shape our climate.
scenes.narration: The ocean stores solar energy and moves it around the planet. This invisible transport helps shape our climate.

scenes.headline: WIND SETS WATER IN MOTION
scenes.caption: Winds push surface currents. Earth's rotation helps bend their paths, forming enormous circulating systems.
scenes.narration: Winds push surface currents. Earth's rotation helps bend their paths, forming enormous circulating systems.

scenes.headline: COLD, SALTY WATER SINKS
scenes.caption: In some polar regions, cooling and salinity make seawater dense enough to sink into the deep ocean.
scenes.narration: In some polar regions, cooling and salinity make seawater dense enough to sink into the deep ocean.

scenes.headline: A SLOW GLOBAL CONNECTION
scenes.caption: Deep currents link ocean basins over long timescales. The circulation is complex, not one simple conveyor belt.
scenes.narration: Deep currents link ocean basins over long timescales. The circulation is complex, not one simple conveyor belt.

scenes.headline: HEAT TRAVELS WITH THE WATER
scenes.caption: Currents redistribute warmth and influence regional weather, marine life, and the exchange of gases.
scenes.narration: Currents redistribute warmth and influence regional weather, marine life, and the exchange of gases.

scenes.headline: THE OCEAN IS NEVER STILL
scenes.caption: Scientists track currents using floats, satellites, and ships to understand how our changing ocean affects Earth.
scenes.narration: Scientists track currents using floats, satellites, and ships to understand how our changing ocean affects Earth.
